title: Microgame contract and MicrogameDefinition asset
description: The microgame abstraction that makes new microgames cheap to add: an explicit lifecycle with win/lose evaluation expressible in pure C#, plus a data-driven ScriptableObject definition. Follows unity-microgame-framework skill.
acceptance_criteria: An IMicrogame / MicrogameBase contract defines the lifecycle: Prepare -> ShowCommand -> Play(timeLimit, perPlayerInput) -> Evaluate (per-player result) -> Cleanup.
A MicrogameResult captures per-player win/lose for a round.
A MicrogameDefinition ScriptableObject carries id, command/verb text, duration, difficulty, and a prefab/address reference.
Pure-logic win/lose evaluation is unit-testable without the engine; a sample fake microgame exercises the full lifecycle in EditMode tests.
